capabilities: Group notes into mountains using community detection
disambiguation: Not a geographical map tool; it visualizes the structure and density of note connections.
intentEvidence: Render your Obsidian link graph as a 3D tilted mountain contour map
problem: Standard 2D graph views fail to intuitively represent the density and hierarchy of connections within a knowledge base.
summary: Renders the Obsidian link graph as a 3D mountain contour map, visualizing note connectivity and hierarchy through altitude and clustering.
